text:
The probabilities of three events A, B and C are
given by 
P(A) = 0.6, P(B) = 0.4 and P(C) = 0.5.

If P(A$\cup$B) = 0.8, P(A$\cap$C) = 0.3, P(A$\cap$B$\cap$C) = 0.2,
P(B$\cap$C) = $β$
 and P(A$\cup$B$\cup$C) = $α$, where
0.85 $\leq α\leq$ 0.95, then $β$ lies in the interval :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2020 (Online) 6th September Evening Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
P(A $\cup$ B) = P(A) + P(B) – P(A $\cap$ B)

$\Rightarrow$ 0.8 = 0.6 + 0.4 – P(A $\cap$ B)

$\Rightarrow$ P(A $\cap$ B) = 0.2

P(A$\cup$B$\cup$C) = P(A) + P(B) + P(C) – P(A $\cap$ B) – P(B $\cap$ C) –P(C $\cap$ A) + P(A $\cap$ B $\cap$ C)

$\Rightarrow$ $α$ = 0.6 + 0.4 + 0.5 - 0.2 - $β$ - 0.3 + 0.2

$\Rightarrow$ $α$ + $β$ = 1.2

$\Rightarrow$ $α$ = 1.2 - $β$

Given, 0.85 $\leq α\leq$ 0.95

$\Rightarrow$ 0.85 $\leq$ 1.2 - $β$ $\leq$ 0.95

$\Rightarrow$ 0.25 $\leq β\leq$ 0.35
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2020 (Online) 6th September Evening Slot

If $α$ and $β$ are the roots of the equation

2x(2x + 1) = 1, then $β$ is equal to :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2020 (Online) 6th September Evening Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$α$ and
$β$ are the roots of the equation

$4x^{2} + 2x – 1 = 0$.

$\therefore$ $α$ + $β$ = $-\frac{1}{2}$

$\Rightarrow$ -1 = 2$α$ + 2$β$

and 4$α^{2}$ + 2$α$ - 1 = 0

$\Rightarrow$ 4$α^{2}$ + 2$α$ + 2$α$ + 2$β$ = 0

$\Rightarrow$ $β$ = $-2α(α+1)$

text:
Let $θ=\frac{π}{5}$ and $A=\left [\begin{array}{ll} \cos θ & \sin θ \\ -\sin θ & \cos θ \end{array}\right ]$. 

 If $B = A + A^{4}$
, then det (B) :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2020 (Online) 6th September Evening Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
For $A=\left [\begin{array}{ll} \cos θ & \sin θ \\ -\sin θ & \cos θ \end{array}\right ]$, multiplying two such matrices adds the angles, so

$A^{n}=\left [\begin{array}{ll} \cos nθ & \sin nθ \\ -\sin nθ & \cos nθ \end{array}\right ].$

Then

$B=A+A^{4}=\left [\begin{array}{ll} \cos θ+\cos 4θ & \sin θ+\sin 4θ \\ -(\sin θ+\sin 4θ) & \cos θ+\cos 4θ \end{array}\right ].$

$\det B=(\cos θ+\cos 4θ)^{2}+(\sin θ+\sin 4θ)^{2}=2+2(\cos 4θ\cos θ+\sin 4θ\sin θ)=2+2\cos 3θ.$

With $θ=\dfrac{π}{5}$, $3θ=108^{\circ }$ and $\cos 108^{\circ }=\cos (90^{\circ }+18^{\circ })=-\sin 18^{\circ }=-\dfrac{\sqrt{5}-1}{4}$.

$\det B=2-\dfrac{\sqrt{5}-1}{2}=\dfrac{5-\sqrt{5}}{2}\approx \dfrac{5-2.236}{2}\approx 1.38,$

which lies in $(1,2)$.

Hence, the correct option is (A).
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2020 (Online) 6th September Evening Slot

text:
If the constant term in the binomial expansion
of 
$\left (\sqrt{x}-\frac{k}{x^{2}}\right )^{10}$ is 405,  then |k| equals :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2020 (Online) 6th September Evening Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$\left (\sqrt{x}-\frac{k}{x^{2}}\right )^{10}$

$(r + 1)^{th}$ term of the expansion,

$T_{r+1} = ^{10}C_{r}\left (\sqrt{x}\right )^{10-r}\left (\frac{-k}{x^{2}}\right )^{r}$

$= ^{10}C_{r}$.$x^{\frac{10-r}{2}}.(-k)^{r}.x^{-2r}$

$= ^{10}C_{r}$.$x^{\frac{10-5r}{2}}.(-k)^{r}$

If it is constant term then 
$\frac{10-5r}{2}$ = 0

$\Rightarrow$ r = 2

$T_{3} = ^{10}C_{2}.(-k)^{2} = 405$

$\Rightarrow$ $k^{2} =$ $\frac{405}{45}$ = 9

$\Rightarrow$ k = $\pm$ 3

$\Rightarrow$ |k| = 3
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2020 (Online) 6th September Evening Slot

solution.body:
[IMG]

text:
For a suitably chosen real constant a, let a

function, $f:R-\{-a\}\to R$  be defined by

$f(x)=\frac{a-x}{a+x}$. Further suppose that for any real
number $x\neq -a$ and $f(x)\neq -a$,

 (fof)(x) = x. Then $f\left (-\frac{1}{2}\right )$ is equal to :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2020 (Online) 6th September Evening Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Given, $f(x)=\frac{a-x}{a+x}$

and (fof)(x) = x

$\Rightarrow$ f(f(x)) = $\frac{a-f(x)}{a+f(x)}$ = x

$\Rightarrow$ $\frac{a-\left (\frac{a-x}{a+x}\right )}{a+\left (\frac{a-x}{a+x}\right )}$ = x

$\Rightarrow$ $\frac{a^{2}+ax-a+x}{a^{2}+ax+a+x}$ = x

$\Rightarrow$ $(a^{2}$
 $– a) + x(a + 1) = (a^{2}$
 $+ a)x + x^{2}(a – 1)$

$\Rightarrow$ $a(a – 1) + x(1 – a^{2}) – x^{2}(a – 1) = 0$

$\Rightarrow$ a = 1

$\therefore$ f(x) = $\frac{1-x}{1+x}$

So, $f\left (-\frac{1}{2}\right )$ = $\frac{1+\frac{1}{2}}{1-\frac{1}{2}}$ = 3
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2020 (Online) 6th September Evening Slot

text:
Let z = x + iy be a non-zero complex number
such that $z^{2}=i|z|^{2}$, where i = $\sqrt{-1}$ , then z lies
on the :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2020 (Online) 6th September Evening Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Given z = x + iy

and $z^{2}=i|z|^{2}$

$\Rightarrow$ $(x + iy)^{2}$
 $= i(x^{2} + y^{2})$

$\Rightarrow$ $x^{2} - y^{2} + 2$ixy $= i(x^{2} + y^{2}) + 0$

Comparing both side we get,

$x^{2} - y^{2} = 0$

$\Rightarrow$ $x^{2} = y^{2}$

and $2xy = (x^{2} + y^{2})$

$\Rightarrow$ $(x - y)^{2} = 0$

$\Rightarrow$ x = y

$\therefore$ z lies on line x = y

text:
Suppose that a function f : R $\to$ R satisfies

f(x + y) = f(x)f(y) for all x, y $\in$ R and f(1) = 3.
 If $\sum\limits _{i=1}^{n}f(i)=363$  then n is equal to $________$ .
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2020 (Online) 6th September Evening Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
f(x + y) = f(x) f(y)

put x = y = 1 

$\therefore$ f(2) = (ƒ$(1))^{2}$
 $= 3^{2}$

put x = 2, y = 1 

$\therefore$ f(3) = (ƒ$(1))^{3}$
 $= 3^{3}$

Similarly $f(x) = 3^{x}$

$\Rightarrow$ $f(i) = 3^{i}$

Given, $\sum\limits _{i=1}^{n}f(i)=363$

$\Rightarrow$ $3 + 3^{2}$
 $+ 3^{3} +.... + 3^{n}$
 = 363

$\Rightarrow$ $\frac{3(3^{n}-1)}{3-1}$ = 363

$\Rightarrow$ $3^{n} - 1 =$ $\frac{363\times 2}{3}$ = 242

$\Rightarrow$ $3^{n} = 243 = 3^{5}$

$\Rightarrow$ n = 5
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2020 (Online) 6th September Evening Slot

that can be formed from all the letters of the
word “LETTER” in which vowels never come
together is $________$ .
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2020 (Online) 6th September Evening Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Consonants $\to$ LTTR

Vowels $\to$ EE

Total No of words = $\frac{6!}{2!2!}$ = 180

Total no of words if vowels are together

= $\frac{5!}{2!}$ = 60

$\therefore$ Total no of words where
 vowels never come together = 180 – 60 = 120.

text:
If $\vec{x}$ and $\vec{y}$ be two non-zero vectors such that
$\left |\vec{x}+\vec{y}\right |=\left |\vec{x}\right |$ and $2\vec{x}+λ\vec{y}$ is perpendicular to $\vec{y}$,
then the value of $λ$ is $_________$ .
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2020 (Online) 6th September Evening Slot via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$\left |\vec{x}+\vec{y}\right |=\left |\vec{x}\right |$

Squaring both sides we get

$\left |\vec{x}\right |^{2}+2\vec{x}.\vec{y}+\left |\vec{y}\right |^{2}=\left |\vec{x}\right |^{2}$

$\Rightarrow$ $2\vec{x}.\vec{y}+\vec{y}.\vec{y}$ = 0 ....(1)

Given $2\vec{x}+λ\vec{y}$ is perpendicular to $\vec{y}$

$\therefore$ $\left (2\vec{x}+λ\vec{y}\right ).\vec{y}$ = 0

$\Rightarrow$ $2\vec{x}.\vec{y}+λ\vec{y}.\vec{y}$ = 0 ....(2)

Comparing (1) & (2) we get, $λ$ = 1
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2020 (Online) 6th September Evening Slot
